title: Flaky Test Suppressions
description: Declares known/reviewed test failures to exclude from the actionable flaky-test report sections.

file.description: Spec file path (relative to cypress/, as it appears in the report)

context.description: Optional context path joined with ' > '. Omit to match any context within the file.

reason.description: Why this failure is suppressed (e.g., 'Known env instability', 'Backend bug under fix')

lastFailedAt.description: Latest observed failure date when the suppression was added

env.description: Environment where the latest observed failure occurred

lastCommit.description: Commit identifier for the latest observed failure when the suppression was added

expiresAt.description: Optional ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) after which suppression auto-expires and the test resurfaces in the report

runSuppressions.description: Entire CI runs to exclude from all stats and failure aggregation (e.g. environment outages that compromised the whole run).

commit.description: Short SHA of the CI commit whose run was compromised (must match the value stored in the ledger)

reason.description: Why the entire run is excluded (e.g., 'CI environment outage — all tests timed out')

suppressedAt.description: Date when the run suppression was added
